signals.review_reason: 主流程阻断: 依赖任务(以^build表示)完全失败,无法继续构建流程。在真实工具链(bunx --bun <cli>)中复现率1.2%+且在合成测试中接近100%,用户被迫手动规避(pnpm改为npm)。属于关键功能不可用+主流程失败,且有明确复现路径和样例链接,满足P0条件。

source_issues.title: Task signaled complete before subprocess writes declared outputs when descendants leave the tracked process group
source_issues.evidence: Synthetic test shows 99.5-100% failure rate for detached/double-fork/delay-pgid modes; real-world `bunx --bun <cli>` tools fail at ~1.2% on Linux CI; dependent tasks fail with 'Could not resolve' errors; Turbo prints 'WARNING no output files found for task'

signals.topic: pnpm v11 devEngines.packageManager not supported — Turborepo rejects workspace
signals.summary: pnpm v11 introduces devEngines.packageManager as the preferred field for specifying the package manager. Turborepo still requires packageManager in package.json and fails with 'Missing packageManager field in package.json', blocking all workspace operations (turbo run, turbo run check-types, etc.).
signals.review_reason: 主流程阻断: 所有 turbo run 命令在 pnpm v11 工作区中失败,错误为'Missing packageManager field',导致用户无法使用 turbo 的任何任务执行功能。虽然是单仓报告,但 pnpm v11 是新发布的主要版本,影响所有升级用户的工作区,是明显的关键功能不可用。

source_issues.title: support `devEngines` with pnpm v11
source_issues.evidence: Running turbo on a pnpm v11 workspace with devEngines.packageManager causes 'Missing packageManager field in package.json' error and blocks turbo run check-types entirely

signals.topic: turbo prune --docker produces invalid output with literal workspaces + bun install
signals.summary: When package.json contains literal (non-glob) workspace entries, turbo prune --docker produces an output directory whose package.json references workspace packages that don't exist in the pruned scope. Running bun install in the pruned output fails with 'Workspace not found' errors. Also affects catalogs feature (bun).
signals.review_reason: 主流程阻断: turbo prune --docker 是构建 Docker 镜像的关键功能,输出不可用导致无法完成 Docker 构建流程。影响使用 bun 的 monorepo 用户的关键构建环节,属于关键功能不可用,虽然 count=1 但有明确复现路径和用户影响证据。

source_issues.title: literal workspaces + `turbo prune --docker` + `bun install` fails
source_issues.evidence: After turbo prune --docker, running bun install in the output directory fails with 'Workspace not found scripts' and 'Workspace not found web-e2e-tests' errors; only occurs when package.json uses literal workspace entries (not globs)

signals.topic: turbo affected fails to resolve main branch in GitHub Actions
signals.summary: In GitHub Actions, turbo affected --tasks build cannot resolve the base branch 'main' because only 'origin/main' exists (not a local 'main' branch). This causes turbo to fall back to assuming all files changed, defeating the purpose of affected-task detection. Users must manually run `git branch main origin/main` as a workaround.
aliases: affected command base branch resolution GitHub Actions
signals.review_reason: 明显体验下降: turbo affected 是 monorepo CI/CD 优化的核心功能,无法正确解析分支导致所有任务都被标记为需执行,破坏了CI效率优化目的。影响所有在GitHub Actions中使用affected命令的用户,是持续集成流程中的关键功能降级。

source_issues.title: `affected` failing to resolve main branch in GitHub action
source_issues.evidence: In GitHub Actions, 'turbo query affected --tasks build' fails to resolve 'main' branch (only origin/main exists), causing all tasks to be marked as changed; CI workflow logs show git error 'ambiguous argument main: unknown revision' and fallback warning

signals.topic: SIGINT not forwarded when script-shell=sh, breaking graceful shutdown
signals.summary: When script-shell is set to sh (default on Windows with npm), Ctrl+C (SIGINT) is not forwarded to child processes. This prevents graceful shutdown handlers from running in the user's code. Works correctly with script-shell=bash. Affects Windows users and Linux users relying on sh.
aliases: SIGINT not propagated to child processes
signals.review_reason: 明显体验下降/关键功能不可用: Windows用户默认使用sh作为script-shell,按Ctrl+C时无法执行优雅关闭流程,导致数据持久化等清理逻辑无法运行。在长时间运行服务(turbo dev/start)中是核心体验问题,且没有简便的workaround,影响CI和生产环境。

source_issues.title: `SIGINT` is not forwarded properly when `script-shell=sh`
source_issues.evidence: With script-shell=sh (default on Windows/npm), pressing Ctrl+C during turbo start never triggers graceful shutdown in the user's code; task exits immediately without running shutdown handlers. Works correctly with bash.

signals.topic: vercel env add with --sensitive flag silently saves empty string instead of value
signals.summary: The CLI command `vercel env add NAME --sensitive --yes --value <value>` reports success (exit 0) but stores an empty string. This is a silent data corruption bug affecting secret/credential management — credentials can silently be wiped with a green success message.
signals.review_reason: Silent data corruption with direct production impact. Two independent reports confirm the same bug across multiple CLI versions (50.x through 53.x). Affects secret/credential management with no error signal — credentials silently become empty strings. This is a P0: main workflow (deployment) can break silently from credential corruption.

source_issues.title: vercel env add --value V --sensitive --yes silently saves empty string
source_issues.evidence: Reproduces on CLI 50.42.0 and 51.6.1. Adding --sensitive causes the value to be dropped before sending to the API. Impact: silently breaks production deploys — author spent hours debugging 'var is set, why is the function 500ing?'. vercel env ls shows 'Encrypted' (looks healthy), but vercel env pull reveals length 0.

source_issues.title: vercel env add reports success but stores empty string (CLI 53.3.2)
source_issues.evidence: Reproduces with --value flag, stdin, and file redirect patterns. High severity: silent failure on env set is dangerous for secret rotation — Stripe webhook secrets, HMAC keys, service role tokens could all silently rotate to empty string with a green CLI receipt. Production outage with no error signal.

signals.topic: Services-mode + middleware.ts causes deployment failure at 'Deploying outputs' stage
signals.summary: When a project uses experimentalServices with at least one non-root service and the web (Next.js) service has a middleware.ts, every deploy fails at the 'Deploying outputs' stage with a generic error. The middleware route src is corrupted by scopeRoutesToServiceOwnership which doesn't exempt middleware routes, causing output finalization to fail deterministically.
signals.review_reason: Main workflow blocked: deployment is a core Vercel workflow and fails deterministically with any middleware.ts in services-mode. Generic error message prevents users from self-diagnosing. Internal support cases and community threads confirm multiple users affected.

source_issues.title: Services-Mode: Middleware routes are not exempted from scopeRoutesToServiceOwnership, breaking deploy outputs
source_issues.evidence: Deterministic, reproducible deployment failure. Adding middleware.ts to a services-mode Next.js app causes every deploy to fail at 'Deploying outputs...' with a generic error. The root cause is identified: scopeRoutesToServiceOwnership corrupts middleware route src with lookahead prefixes without exempting middleware routes. Removal of middleware.ts restores successful deploys. Internal support cases referenced (01kpgVUAoxBA9kuW, 01161162). Community threads confirm broader pattern.

signals.topic: vercel logs returns duplicate entries with pagination when --limit > 50
signals.summary: The `vercel logs --json --limit N` command returns duplicate log entries when more than 50 logs exist in the time window. The API ignores the page parameter and returns the same first page repeatedly, causing the CLI to accumulate duplicate entries until --limit is reached.
signals.review_reason: Observability tooling returns corrupted/incomplete data. Users cannot rely on log output for debugging when pagination is involved. However, count=1 and this is a non-blocking issue — users can still read logs, just with duplicates. Downgraded to P2.

source_issues.title: vercel logs returns duplicate entries when there are more than 50 results and --limit > 50
source_issues.evidence: Root cause identified: the API endpoint ignores page N and returns the same first page each time while reporting pagination.hasMore: true. The CLI pagination loop is correct; the server-side API is the culprit. Verified with awk dedup analysis showing 100 total results but only 50 unique.

signals.topic: @rollup/rollup-linux-x64-gnu native module missing causes serverless function runtime failure
signals.summary: Serverless functions using Vite/rollup fail at runtime with MODULE_NOT_FOUND for @rollup/rollup-linux-x64-gnu. This is a known npm optional-dependency bug that causes FUNCTION_INVOCATION_FAILED, blocking the entire function execution.
signals.review_reason: Known serverless function runtime failure that blocks the deployed function from executing. However, this is a known npm optional-dependency issue (referenced npm/cli#4828) that is not unique to Vercel. Single report from 2024 still open, with recent activity — indicates unresolved but niche impact. Count=1, downgraded to P2.

source_issues.title: ERROR: @rollup/rollup-linux-x64-gnu not found for serverless function running on Vercel
source_issues.evidence: Reproducible serverless function runtime failure. Express.js app deployed as serverless function fails with MODULE_NOT_FOUND for @rollup/rollup-linux-x64-gnu. Workarounds attempted (explicit install, direct import) all fail. Function invocation fails with FUNCTION_INVOCATION_FAILED.

signals.topic: Multiple AI feature initialization failures: GitHub Copilot sign-in error, Inline Assist external agent not picked up, OpenCode free models not visible
signals.summary: Three separate AI-related issues where key AI features fail to initialize or display: (1) Copilot sign-in throws 'copilot hasn't started yet' / 'window not found' error, (2) Inline Assist ignores external agent preference, (3) OpenCode free models not visible in model list despite connection.
aliases: Copilot sign in error window not found
Inline Assist external agent preference ignored
OpenCode free models not visible model list
signals.review_reason: 3个issue指向同一主题：AI功能初始化/配置问题导致关键AI功能(Copilot、Inline Assist、OpenCode)无法正常使用或显示。count=3，合并后P2级别，虽非完全阻断但影响明显。

source_issues.title: Can not connect Zed to GitHub Copilot
source_issues.evidence: Sign-in popup shows 'An Error Happened - Copilot has issues starting'. Logs show 'copilot hasn't started yet' and 'window not found' errors.

source_issues.title: Inline Assist not picking up my external agen
source_issues.evidence: User selects external agent but Inline Assist uses Zed native instead of the chosen agent.

source_issues.title: I do not see Opencode Free models
source_issues.evidence: OpenCode free models (DeepSeek V4 Flash Free, Ring 2.6 1T Free) not visible in model list despite successful connection.

signals.topic: REPL hangs indefinitely on Jupyter kernels that defer stdin socket binding (e.g. IHaskell)
signals.summary: When using Zed's REPL with Jupyter kernels like IHaskell that don't bind a stdin socket at startup, the REPL hangs forever on 'Connecting to kernel…' and never completes, making the REPL completely unusable for affected kernels.
signals.review_reason: 用户主流程(REPL执行代码)被完全阻断，受影响内核无法正常使用。虽count=1，但影响明确(无限等待)且无内置workaround，属于P1级别阻断性问题。

source_issues.title: REPL hangs on Jupyter kernels that don't bind a stdin socket at start up (e.g. IHaskell)
source_issues.evidence: REPL hangs indefinitely on 'Connecting to kernel…' with IHaskell kernel. No workaround within Zed; requires patching either Zed or the kernel.

signals.topic: Zed terminal unusable on Linux via Flatpak due to library conflicts (Fedora/rpm-ostree)
signals.summary: On Fedora/rpm-ostree systems running Zed via Flatpak, the embedded terminal fails to run any commands due to libselinux/libostree/g_uri_get_fragment symbol conflicts, rendering the terminal completely non-functional.
signals.review_reason: 用户在Flatpak+Fedora/rpm-ostree环境下，终端功能完全不可用(所有命令均失败)，属于关键功能阻断。count=1但影响明确。

source_issues.title: library-conflict on Zed terminal startup via flatpak
source_issues.evidence: Terminal shows 'symbol lookup error: undefined symbol: g_uri_get_fragment' and 'no version information available (required by...)' errors; every command in terminal fails.

signals.topic: Zed Sign In button stuck on 'Signing in…' indefinitely, blocking authentication
signals.summary: Clicking the Sign In button shows 'Signing in…' forever without completing authentication, preventing users from signing into Zed.dev accounts.
signals.review_reason: 认证流程被完全阻断，用户无法登录Zed账户，导致所有依赖登录的功能不可用。影响明确，优先级P1。

source_issues.title: "Sign in" button just says "Signing in..." and then does nothing
source_issues.evidence: Button shows 'Signing in...' state indefinitely with no error or completion. User cannot authenticate to Zed.dev.

signals.topic: Windows Restart-to-Update loop: Zed repeatedly restarts without applying updates
signals.summary: On Windows, clicking 'Restart to Update' causes Zed to restart but loads the old version, then prompts for update again, creating an infinite loop. Users must manually quit and relaunch to complete the update.
signals.review_reason: Windows用户无法通过内置更新机制完成升级，必须手动干预，属于关键发布流程失败。P1级别。

source_issues.title: Windows: clicking Restart to Update does not work
source_issues.evidence: Update loop: restart loads old version -> prompts update again -> restart loads old version -> repeat indefinitely. Workaround requires manual quit and restart.
